comment: All dimensions in inches unless noted. Orientation matches owner sketches and the Compass marketing plans: bottom of plan = north (Panama Ave side), left = east (property-line side), top = south (backyard). Addition local x=0 at the addition's ground-floor east exterior face (5 ft from the east property line), increasing west; y=0 at the existing house rear wall, increasing south.

existing_house.comment: From the 2021 Compass marketing floor plan (approximate; field-verify). Local x of interior wall centerlines measured west from the addition's east face.

first_floor.corridor_note: Corridor is a bump-out of the DINING room: it spans the dining room's rear wall (new opening + header) and flows into the addition's entry; no separate hall. Main block narrowed to 14 ft so the corridor south wall is wide enough for a 6 ft double sliding door to the backyard. Closet runs east-west against the bathroom wall; bedroom deepened to keep a king bed comfortable.

second_floor.note: West wall cantilevers 2'-6" beyond the narrowed first-floor west wall (joists span E-W, back-span 10 ft).

stair.note: Straight run along south wall, bottom at west, rising to the east; top landing at the second-floor entry door (SE corner).

site_ft.note: Front setback assumed 20 ft (verify); house footprint from the Compass marketing plan. Shed position approximate from the marketing site plan.
